docs.summary: Files on a web server. The server lists them in an index file, one path per line relative to the root URL, and serves each at the root URL plus its path. Reading downloads the file, so prefer loading these assets asynchronously.
Goes into every GUID the source's files get, so the same path in two sources is two different assets.
